title: 第23章 看看喜欢哪个第24章 心意相通
lines: 第23章看看喜欢哪个
距离青城嘉园6公里左右的茶桂公园。
葱郁的梧桐树下，一道纤瘦的身影盘腿坐在树荫处看着书。
火牙狗已经忘记自己绕着这个公园跑了多少圈。
每当它跑累了回到自家御兽师面前，就看见自家御兽师用充满信任的目光对着自己喊加油，让它总感觉自己很厉害还可以继续。
等它回过神来的时候就发现自己又已经在跑了……
乔桑合上书，看着不远处以龟速在前进的火牙狗摇摇头。
火牙狗不行啊，这才跑了十圈就虚了。
晨跑训练不了火牙狗的速度，顶多是锻炼一下它的体能，也能让乔桑大概知道火牙狗的体能极限在哪里。
等到火牙狗再次坚持跑到乔桑面前的时候早上的晨跑算是告一段落。
乔桑将早就买好的奇源牛奶递到火牙狗面前。
奇源牛奶是提供给宠兽的饮品，算是市面上口碑比较好的品牌，能稍微补充一下宠兽的体能，是乔桑在路边一家专门给宠兽做食物的早餐店买的。
这种涉及到宠兽的东西价格总是虚高，但奇源牛奶几十年如一日，从出厂到现在都没有涨过价，一瓶只用98联盟币。
火牙狗伸出无力的爪子接过牛奶咕噜咕噜地喝了起来，没几口瓶子就见了底。
火牙狗朝着乔桑投来渴望的目光。
乔桑一愣，她就买了一瓶……
顶不住火牙狗的眼神，乔桑将一旁了3联盟币给自己顺道买的豆递了过去。
火牙狗看着眼前只剩下一口的豆沉默了一会。
火牙狗湿漉漉的眼睛满是控诉。
“好好好，等等再给你买。”乔桑安抚道。
再苦不能苦了宠兽，要是自家宠兽的腹欲都满足不了怎么能让它好好训练？
咱现在怎么说也是有50000联盟币的人了，不就是奇源牛奶吗？
买！
十五分钟后。
乔桑拎着一大袋奇源牛奶陷入了沉思。
这50000联盟币应该经得起她一段时间吧……
等到火牙狗喝完三瓶，袋子里还剩下七瓶奇源牛奶。
四瓶奇源牛奶下肚火牙狗总算精神了起来，可四肢还是酸软，连走路都颤颤巍巍的。
乔桑见状没让它立马进行技能释放训练。
“我带你去买个好东西。”乔桑对着火牙狗笑道。
火牙狗眼睛一亮，显然对这个好东西很感兴趣。
维列广场。
唐新片区最大的购物中心，集休闲，购物，餐饮，娱乐为一体的精品商业综合广场。
乔桑刚到就被一位长相帅气，有着一头蓝色狼尾发型的青年给拦住了。
“美女，有兴趣了解一下如何让宠兽变得更加有魅力吗？来我们梦丽兽兽造型室吧，我们有专业的宠兽造型师团队，我们的首席造型师更是为罗刚选手的紫魔藤设计过造型。”
“谢谢，我没有兴趣。”乔桑拒绝道。
“美女，先不要着急拒绝，看看我这只青悦蝶。”狼尾发型青年说着往旁边迈了一步。
他的身后一只全身蓝紫色有着青色脉纹翅膀的青悦蝶出现在乔桑眼前。

Chapter 23 See which one you like
Chagui Park is about 6 kilometers away from Qingcheng Jiayuan.
Under the lush sycamore tree, a slender figure sat cross-legged in the shade and read a book.
Firefang had forgotten how many times he had run around the park.
Whenever it gets tired from running and returns to its master, it will see its master looking at it with trusting eyes and shouting "come on", making it always feel that it is very powerful and can continue.
When it came back to its senses, it found that it was already running again...
Qiao Sang closed the book, looked at the fire-toothed dog that was advancing at a turtle's speed not far away, and shook his head.
The Fire Tooth Dog is not good, it only ran ten laps and then it was exhausted.
Morning jogging cannot train the speed of the Fire Tooth Dog. At most, it can exercise its physical fitness, and it can also give Qiao Sang a rough idea of ​​where the Fire Tooth Dog's physical limit is.
The morning run came to an end when the fire-toothed dog insisted on running to Qiao Sang again.
Qiao Sang handed the Qiyuan milk he had bought long ago to Huoyang Dog.
Qiyuan milk is a drink provided to pet beasts. It is a brand with a good reputation on the market. It can slightly supplement the pet beast's physical fitness. Qiao Sang bought it at a breakfast shop on the roadside that specializes in making food for pet beasts.
The price of such things involving pet animals is always exaggerated, but Qiyuan milk has remained the same for decades, and the price has not increased since it left the factory. A bottle only costs 98 alliance coins.
The fire-toothed dog stretched out its weak paws to take the milk and drank it in a gurgling manner. After a few sips, the bottle reached the bottom.
"Teeth."
The fire-toothed dog cast a longing look at Qiao Sang.
Qiao Sang was stunned, and she bought a bottle...
Unable to withstand the fire-toothed dog's gaze, Qiao Sang handed over the beans he bought along with 3 alliance coins.
Huoya Dog looked at Dou with only one mouthful left in front of him and was silent for a while.
"Tooth!"
The fire-toothed dog's wet eyes were full of accusations.
"Okay, okay, I'll buy it for you later." Qiao Sang reassured.
No matter how hard it is for your pet, if you can't satisfy your pet's desires, how can you train it well?
No matter what, we now have 50,000 alliance coins. Isn’t it Qiyuan Milk?
purchase!
Fifteen minutes later.
Qiao Sang was carrying a large bag of Qiyuan milk and fell into deep thought.
These 50,000 alliance coins should be able to withstand her for a while...
When Huoyang Dog finished three bottles, there were still seven bottles of Qiyuan milk left in the bag.
After four bottles of Qiyuan milk, Huoyang Dog finally regained his energy, but his limbs were still sore and weak, and he was trembling even when he walked.
When Qiao Sang saw this, he did not immediately let it perform skill release training.
"I'll take you to buy something good." Qiao Sang smiled at the fire-toothed dog.
"Teeth."
Fire Tooth Dog's eyes lit up, obviously he was very interested in this good thing.
…
Place de Villiers.
The largest shopping mall in Tangxin area, it is a boutique commercial comprehensive plaza integrating leisure, shopping, dining and entertainment.
As soon as Qiao Sang arrived, he was stopped by a handsome young man with a blue wolf tail hairstyle.
"Beauty, are you interested in learning how to make your pet beast more attractive? Come to our Dream Beast Styling Room. We have a professional team of pet stylists. Our chief stylist has even designed the style for contestant Luo Gang's Purple Magic Vine."
"Thank you, I'm not interested." Qiao Sang refused.
"Beauty, don't refuse in a hurry, take a look at my Qingyue Butterfly." The young man with the wolf tail hair said and took a step to the side.
Behind him, a blue-purple butterfly with green veined wings appeared in front of Qiao Sang.
